title: Finishing the Lānaʻi field house
summary: At the April 15 meeting, the chair said she will share the field house sports programs proposal with staff so members can have a copy. The proposal follows a request from a speaker for local coaches, who asked for money to add an extended roof and gutters to the Lānaʻi Field House.
